subject.title: Feature: fallbackChannel for hook mappings when primary delivery fails

question: Should hook delivery support ordered cross-channel failover, and what target binding and retryable-failure rules should become the public config contract?
rationale: Current main has no established contract for replaying generated hook content to another channel, and choices around ambiguous sends, privacy, duplicate prevention, and failure notifications cannot be resolved safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Add explicit destination list
options.body: Add ordered destinations containing channel, target, and account, with failover limited to clearly pre-delivery failures and full delivery tracing.

options.title: Use failure notifications
options.body: Keep original hook delivery single-target and send a separate failure alert through the existing failure-destination model.

options.title: Require caller routing
options.body: Keep hooks single-target and require external orchestration to select a reachable destination before dispatch.

recommendation.title: Add explicit destination list
recommendation.body: Add ordered destinations containing channel, target, and account, with failover limited to clearly pre-delivery failures and full delivery tracing.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across hook dispatch and cron delivery and already reviewed this exact product gap.
